query: SELECT weekNumber, COUNT(*) as total_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN subgroup IN ('Revolution Canton Check-In', 'Revolution Jasper Check-In') THEN campus END) as checkin_campuses FROM attendance_weekly WHERE year = 2026 AND weekNumber IN (20, 21) GROUP BY weekNumber ORDER BY weekNumber DESC;
